regress_scope_outage_pause: a scope-service outage during re-validation after a scope change paused the run forever (inv_11). Fixed in engine/effects_scope.go revalidate. regress_comp_cancelled_on_resume: the next owner of a cancelled run closed the in-flight compensation effect as cancelled; a zombie worker's late undo then ran out of reverse order (inv_07). Fixed in engine/compensate.go closeOpenBody.
